decision.disposition: MODIFY; neither universal keep-zero nor universal keep-reconstruction criterion passes
decision.reason: Primary R95 falls on E009 but rises on oral. E009 gains one>=50% target and slightly better bacterial geometry/B3/assignment; oral post gains2>=50%/1>=90% targets and less unassigned DNA but weaker parent recovery/bp-weighted neighborhoods/B3. Do not pool truth scopes or select per dataset/bin.
decision.working_policy: Keep reconstruction and the existing dev5 source/defaults provisionally as the fixed implementation anchor, retaining zero as a useful matched alternative. This is continuity under mixed evidence, not proof the reconstruction family is necessary or optimal.
decision.next: One coherent positive-only online/EMA-target multiview training candidate, grounded in the reviewed McDevol/BYOL mechanism. Keep current composition/depth encoders, real parent/crop bank, measured-parent depth, reconstruction coefficients, seed/schedule, unit inference geometry and CPM/E013 fixed initially. Predictor, stop-gradient target and EMA/collapse contracts form one learning bundle; no teacher or new fit runs here.
decision.why_next: Zero reconstruction trades E009 recovery for oral post-refinement recovery and does not resolve weak oral neighborhoods or representation/grouping mismatch. The current objective still repels different parents from the same genome. Positive-only learning removes that assumption while retaining real within-parent pairs, without trusting oral nearest-neighbor origins at only20.6% agreement. This is a testable hypothesis, not a demonstrated cause or guaranteed gain.
decision.alternatives: Conservative false-negative masking/cross-contig mining is serious, but the present oral neighbor purity makes unfiltered pseudo-positive links unsafe; a reliable rule is still unadmitted. Weight/resolution grids, a larger network or another mature tool are lower-priority alternatives, not ruled out.
decision.confirmation: Both communities remain development. Prospectively name an untouched additional community and freeze source/genome/replicon/molecule/taxonomy/overlap/unique-vs-origin/full-denominator/length/depth/evaluation/cost/retention admission before acquisition/confirmation. None acquired now.
decision.source_scope: Existing completed source/design reviews reused. Current targeted refresh reads BYOL abstract and McDevol author README, not a new complete implementation audit. BYOL online/target moving-average mechanism is supported; new binning benefit/collapse robustness remains untested.
